text: Determine what authoritative machine-readable complete-unit budget data currently exists for each of the ten AVAILABLE owners and where current code permits caller understatement or lacks evidence.
acceptance_intent: Return exact producer, fields, units, and coverage; absent values remain explicit and are never inferred from prose.

planner_obligations.description: Carry authoritative per-owner complete-unit budget inputs and fail-closed missing-evidence states into planning.

text: Every executable owner must derive its complete atomic UnitBudget from its content-addressed owner contract before preparation or launch; callers cannot supply or understate it.
acceptance_intent: Admission includes core, three gates, adjudication, and materialization overhead and rejects missing, incomplete, or insufficient budgets before side effects.

planner_obligations.description: Plan per-owner derivation, understatement rejection, missing-evidence rejection, and pre-effect admission tests.

text: Determine the current durable effect identities and authoritative observables available to reconcile STARTED effects for the ten AVAILABLE owners after interruption.
acceptance_intent: Map each owner to a real same-path observable or explicit unresolved state without rerunning a possibly applied effect.

planner_obligations.description: Carry owner-specific effect identity and reconciliation evidence boundaries into planning.

text: Resume must reconcile a STARTED effect through its owner-specific typed contract into ALREADY_APPLIED, NOT_APPLIED, or genuinely unresolved before deciding whether execution can continue.
acceptance_intent: A crash after side effect and before result persistence never blindly duplicates the effect and can terminalize when authoritative state proves completion.

planner_obligations.description: Plan red-before/green-after crash-window and idempotent-resume verification for each supported reconciliation class.

text: Determine the authoritative terminal schema, pass marker, artifact, or state observable for each of the ten AVAILABLE owners and prove where current runtime equates exit zero with success.
acceptance_intent: Return exact semantic terminal evidence or an explicit fail-closed absence for every AVAILABLE owner.

planner_obligations.description: Carry semantic verification and one-terminal-event contracts into planning.

text: Process exit zero cannot terminalize an owner; the runtime must validate its content-addressed terminal schema and append exactly one durable terminal event only after semantic verification passes.
acceptance_intent: Missing or malformed envelope, absent pass signal, failed artifact/state check, and replayed terminalization all fail visibly and deterministically.

planner_obligations.description: Plan semantic success/failure and exactly-once terminal event tests.

text: Determine which registered owners are non-standalone children, the authoritative parent relation, and the current dispatch path that permits direct execution.
acceptance_intent: Name the exact child row, parent owner, required active parent context, and rejection boundary.

planner_obligations.description: Carry the child-only delegation contract and standalone rejection boundary into planning.

text: A non-standalone child owner must be invokable only through a validated active parent adapter context and must reject direct selection or dispatch.
acceptance_intent: Direct child intent fails before side effects; parent-bound invocation preserves parent run, policy, and lifecycle identity.

planner_obligations.description: Plan direct-rejection, forged-parent, stale-parent, and valid-delegation tests.

text: Determine the current effective parameter schemas, enum/tag rules, repository-root bindings, and path normalization behavior for the ten AVAILABLE owners.
acceptance_intent: Prove which parameter and path constraints are authoritative versus hardcoded, absent, or only prose.

planner_obligations.description: Carry materialized schema and trusted-root resolution contracts into planning.

text: Every owner parameter must validate against the content-addressed materialized schema; paths must be normalized, reject absolute or traversal escapes, and resolve only through named trusted repository-root bindings before argv construction.
acceptance_intent: Wrong type/tag/enum, extra or missing field, unknown root, absolute path, traversal, and symlink escape fail before command construction or effects.

planner_obligations.description: Plan complete schema, trusted-root, and path-escape acceptance tests.
